name.description: Name attribute shared by all radios of the group. Required.

id.description: Id the description element is derived from. Generated with a random suffix when omitted, so the same field can render twice on one page.

options.description: Radios as a list of { value, label, id?, checked?, disabled? }. Pass Sw:Form:Radio components as content instead to render them yourself.

value.description: Value of the radio that is checked.

description.description: Hint below the legend. Linked to the radios via aria-describedby.

disabled.description: Disables every radio of the group.

validationRules.description: Comma separated list of client-side validation rules, rendered as data-validation on each radio.

violationPath.description: Key the server-side violations of this group are stored under.

formViolations.description: ConstraintViolationException holding the server-side violations of the request. Defaults to the `formViolations` Twig global; pass it explicitly to render a field outside a request scope.

required.description: Renders the required marker in the legend and aria-required on the radios.

isInvalid.description: Marks every radio of the group invalid.
